properties.aip_source: NOT PUBLISHED IN ENR 2.1 - values unchanged, unverified

properties.name: U-TAPAO TMA
properties.aip_note: AIP publishes two concentric steps, both to UNL: 5-15 NM = 700 ft AGL to UNL; 15-50 NM = 2000 ft AGL to UNL. Lower limit here is the 15-50 NM step. Excludes U-Tapao CTR, Bangkok TMA, Alfa CTA, Hua Hin TMA, and A464/R468/G463/G458 FL65-FL460.

properties.name: NARATHIWAT TMA
properties.aip_note: AIP publishes two volumes: (1) 25 NM circle on NTW, ALT 11000 / 2000 ft; (2) southern extension, ALT 11000 / 4000 ft. Geometry is a single part, so the 11000/2000 volume is recorded here.
